title: 万泉河 (万泉庄-巴沟-畅春园) Wanquan He
subtitle: a canal · outside the walls · confidence A, assumed

facts.label: Name
facts.value: 万泉河 (万泉庄-巴沟-畅春园) Wanquan He

facts.label: In English
facts.value: River of Ten Thousand Springs, upper reach to 畅春园

facts.label: What it was
facts.value: a canal outside the garden walls

facts.label: Size
facts.value: 9-10.5 km whole river today (S1224, two figures)

facts.label: Where
facts.value: osm way 23426825 (万泉河, canal) from 巴沟 north to 39.9912: today's straightened channel (1980s, S1224) in the old valley west of the town: C for the line

facts.label: Note
facts.value: [j99:10a] 水之由萬泉莊注巴溝由巴溝入暢春園者; [j79:11b] 萬泉莊髙於巴溝巴溝又髙於丹稜沜. The feed of 畅春园 and, through it and the 马厂, of 圆明园 (贾 2024: 引玉泉山水、万泉河水入园). Malone p.103: the emperor came to 畅春园 by boat on the canal through the rice fields from 万泉庄.

sources.text: Carroll Brown Malone, History of the Peking Summer Palaces under the Ch'ing Dynasty, Illinois Studies in the Social Sciences XIX, Urbana 1934; reprint Paragon 1966
